mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS grow, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals overheating that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and INDPRO rises, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment expansion regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates supply-side disruption that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO grows and GDPC1 declines, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
